Public Portion 
 1. Discussion on the Fiscal Accountability & Budget Review Special Committee 
 
Minutes: 
On July 13, 2026, the Finance Committee, chaired by Councilor Zaida Govan, convened to begin 
the work of the Fiscal Accountability and Budget Review Special Committee. The committee 
discussed its goal of reviewing departmental budgets to promote fiscal accountability, increase 
transparency, and identify opportunities to reduce the long-term impact of budget growth on 
taxpayers. 
The chair reported that requests for detailed budget information had been sent to several City 
departments, including Finance, Public Works, and Planning. Committee members stated that the 
review process is intended to improve understanding of departmental spending, identify potential 
efficiencies, and develop recommendations for future budget cycles. The committee 
acknowledged that the current fiscal year budget has already been adopted but expressed interest 
in exploring options to reduce future property tax impacts. 
Members also discussed the financial challenges facing residents and the importance of 
maintaining responsible fiscal planning as they evaluate available revenue sources. The 
committee indicated that future meetings will be scheduled as departmental budget information 
is received and reviewed. 
Meeting adjourned: 5:35 p.m.
